name: proto-hand-serializer-reads
description: A hand call of a serializer that encodes a message reads every field reachable from the message type it encodes through field types, the fields of a nested message included, because the bytes it produces are observable; a message outside that closure that hand code only writes keeps its field unreferenced.
pending: bindings.15: deadset-go and deadset-ts read the closure of a message a hand-written serializer call encodes (GO5, J7).
